lines.text: Happy birthday, dear guest.
Please don't be alarmed, I was just so delighted to know you'd come here. Have a seat.
You are here for a very special reason, do you know why that is?
You've been chosen for your excellent skills as a manager of the squadrons you've led throughout your career. That's the type of person I'm looking for to be in charge of a very special mission.
Oh? Then tell me.
...How clever, that's correct!
...Ground zero.
I am reuniting a squad to delve deep into the ground zero of the virus outbreak, where it all started.
I call it... the Frail Initiative.
Oh? So you're calling it quits? Is that what I'm hearing?
Very well.
The Frail Initiative was created to investigate the ground zero in search of clues to what may have caused the Havoc virus outbreak, in an effort to produce a cure with our finds.
You may be thinking it's too dangerous for a squad to go to these depths, however...
The Frail Initiative is formed by a group of the strongest humans available on earth.

Your everyday Havoc threat is nothing more than child's play for those individuals. But the ground zero still poses a great threat regardless of our group's level, and that's where you come in, dear manager.
Are we on the same page? Hm?
I am delighted to hear that. However... you must pass a test to get the job.
Look over the table next to you, the papers and pen should be at your disposal. Good luck.
Hmmmmm... well...
Con-gra..........tulations!!!!!!! You may now blow out the candle, Mr. Manager, it's your birthday!!!
Okay Mr. Manager, now sign this contract right here.
That settles it! The Frail Initiative welcomes you with open arms.
Now get out of my clinic!!! Your first day will be tomorrow in the Z district at 6. I do hope you are prepared.
Oh, and you may take the cake.
Hmmmmm.... No, that's not quite it.
I'm afraid our birthday party here is over. Out of here!!
